description:
Discover San Diego’s breathtaking beauty during golden hour on our exclusive Chasing Sunsets Tour—a 3-hour journey along the Pacific Coast designed to capture the most magical moments of the day.

Begin your adventure in a picturesque seaside town like La Jolla or Ocean Beach, and follow a curated route designed by our expert local guides. Along the way, you'll enjoy private round-trip transportation, 3–4 stunning coastal viewpoints, a wine and olive tasting stop, and time to walk, explore, and take incredible sunset photos.

Whether you're a nature lover, photographer, or just seeking a peaceful evening experience, this tour delivers the perfect blend of sightseeing and relaxation.

itinerary:
5:00 PM – Guest Pick-Up
Meet your local bilingual guide and begin the journey in private transportation.

5:30 PM – Arrival at First Sunset Viewpoint
Enjoy panoramic views at spots like La Jolla Cove, Sunset Cliffs, or Ocean Beach.

6:15 PM – Wine & Olive Tasting Stop
Visit a local shop to sample regional wines and olives. Bottled water and light snacks included.

7:00 PM – Main Sunset Viewpoint
Relax and watch the sun set over the Pacific Ocean — perfect for photos and soaking in the golden hour.

7:45 PM – Scenic Drive Back
Enjoy a relaxing drive back along the coast.

8:00 PM – Drop-Off at Original Location
Return to your pick-up spot with beautiful memories and photos

Q: What is not included?

Q: Where are the viewpoints? Which stops will we visit?
A: Typical stops include:

Sunset Cliffs Natural Park — dramatic cliffs and crashing waves.

Mt. Soledad — sweeping panoramic views of the entire city.

Windansea Beach — textured rock formations, local favourite. 
SAN DIEGO TOURS AND EXPERIENCES

Additional “secret” coastal parks and off-the-beaten-path lookouts.

Q: When should I plan for the tour? What time does it begin?
A: Because this is a sunset-coastline experience, the departure is timed to allow you to arrive at scenic view-points just before or during golden hour / sunset. Exact start time depends on season and your pickup location. We recommend booking for 4 hours that end with the sunset.

Q: Are pick-up and drop-off included? Can you pick us up anywhere in San Diego?
A: Yes — private round-trip transportation from your location in San Diego is included. 
SAN DIEGO TOURS AND EXPERIENCES
 Please specify your preferred pickup location when booking so we can plan logistics accordingly (travel time, traffic, etc.).

Q: Is this tour suitable for children, seniors, or people with limited mobility?
A: The service is private and customizable, but note that some walking is required at viewpoints and cliff-edge parks. If anyone has mobility constraints, please let us know in advance so we can adapt stops, choose easier viewpoints, or ensure minimal walking.

Q: What should I bring/wear?
A: We recommend:

Comfortable shoes suitable for uneven terrain or cliffside paths.

A light jacket or layer — coastal breezes go up at sunset.

A camera or phone with good battery for photo-opportunities.

Optional: sunglasses, hat, and a reusable water bottle (though bottled water is provided).

If you wish to purchase the picnic upgrade, consider bringing any special dietary items or preferences.

Q: What happens in case of bad weather (fog, rain)?
A: Coastal weather can change quickly. If sunset is obscured by heavy fog or rain, we’ll still proceed with the tour and select the best viewpoints possible. If conditions make the tour unsafe (e.g., heavy rain, strong winds), we’ll offer to reschedule or provide an alternative plan.
